result.reason: The addition reaches the preferred position: transition assistance is available for up to six months at TrueLink’s then-current rates, specified Client-related data must be returned within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and TrueLink must thereafter delete and certify deletion. The amendment is confined to post-termination obligations and does not disturb unrelated commercial terms. Drafting is professional, though “thereafter” leaves the deletion deadline somewhat open-ended and the data categories should ideally align with a single defined term such as “Customer Data.”
